description:
A capability granted to a principal (proposal §12).

The principal is identified by ``principal_type`` (``agent`` or ``machine``)
and ``principal_id``.  ``scope`` optionally narrows the grant (e.g. a single
repository id); ``expires_at`` bounds it in time (``None`` = no expiry).

capability.description: Open dot-namespaced capability (e.g. 'repo.write'). A Capability registry value today; any well-formed domain.verb string tomorrow (default-deny keeps an unrecognised capability harmless).
capability.title: Capability

expires_at.description: Grant expiry (UTC); None means no expiry.
expires_at.title: Expires At

grant_id.description: Prefixed ULID for this durable grant record (grant_...).
grant_id.title: Grant Id

granted_by.description: Id of the principal or policy that issued the grant.
granted_by.title: Granted By

principal_id.description: Id of the granted agent or machine.
principal_id.title: Principal Id

scope.description: Optional scope narrowing the grant (e.g. a repository id).
scope.title: Scope

title: CapabilityGrant
